inlines.text: 打造一个人们真正愿意与之交谈的语音智能体，光有好嗓音远远不够，还需要对话、智能与行动三者恰到好处地同时配合。MAI Realtime 1 通过以下能力实现了这一点：
MAI Realtime 1 能处理打断、跟上简短的回应，也知道何时该等对方把话说完
：快速响应的系统让对话实时流畅进行。当任务需要更深入的思考时，它会调用更强大的推理引擎，给出周全的答案，而不会出现尴尬的停顿
即使有背景噪音或他人在说话，它也能识别请求
它能承接复杂请求，并连接企业系统和工具，让语音智能体不只是回答问题
通过提示词即可调整语气、风格和行为，以适配不同的客户、领域和用例

blocks.text: MAI Realtime 1: Leading voice AI at $0.01 per audio minute

inlines.text: MAI Realtime 1: Leading voice AI at $0.01 per audio minute

blocks.text: Nov 17, 2026 ·Ignite ·Models
MAI Realtime 1, our first speech-to-speech model, is built for naturally flowing conversations for real-world enterprise applications starting at $0.01 per audio minute.1

inlines.text: MAI Realtime 1, our first speech-to-speech model, is built for naturally flowing conversations for real-world enterprise applications starting at

blocks.text: Our model outperforms GPT Realtime 2.1 on quality, speed, and price across public benchmarks and Microsoft product evaluations. It sits on the performance-price Pareto frontier for both Big Bench Audio speech reasoning, and Tau-Voice agentic task completion benchmark.2

inlines.text: Our model outperforms GPT Realtime 2.1 on quality, speed, and price across public benchmarks and Microsoft product evaluations. It sits on the performance-price Pareto frontier for both Big Bench Audio speech reasoning, and Tau-Voice agentic task completion benchmark.

blocks.text: Natural conversations that get things done

inlines.text: Natural conversations that get things done

blocks.text: Building a voice agent people actually want to talk to takes more than just a good voice. It takes the right mix of conversation, intelligence, and action working together simultaneously. MAI Realtime 1 brings that together through the following capabilities:

inlines.text: Building a voice agent people actually want to talk to takes more than just a good voice. It takes the right mix of conversation, intelligence, and action working together simultaneously. MAI Realtime 1 brings that together through the following capabilities:
MAI Realtime 1 manages interruptions, follows quick acknowledgments, and knows when to wait for someone to finish speaking

: A fast, responsive system keeps the conversation flowing in real time. When a task requires deeper thinking, it taps into a more powerful reasoning engine delivering thoughtful answers without awkward pauses
It recognizes requests even with background noise or other people talking
It takes on complex requests and connects to enterprise systems and tools, so voice agents can do more than simply answer questions
It adjusts tone, style, and behavior through prompting to suit different customers, domains, and use cases

blocks.text: MAI Realtime 1 is also compatible with the OpenAI Realtime API, making it straightforward for developers to test the model and migrate existing voice applications.
